text: Long time ago, tribe do trade like normal.
Me give you goat, you give me stick.
Plus me can now use stick to take goat.
But one day, clever weasel man say,
If you big brain, you get rich.
If you no big brain, you become employee.
Employee just caveman who decole for other caveman coin.
But what happen if people make thing together?
It big tribe with leader who sit and take all coin.
They marry it, eat it, and wear its skin like loincloth.
And deep spiritual hole where cave soul used to be.
Like tribe member who twist ankle on hunt.
But too big for uppy uppy.
So lesson is coin like evil god.
But if you worship, you end up empty.
With many thing but no peace.
And remember you no take coin to after life.
